svg.title: Unilog responsive wireframe contact sheet
svg.desc: Fourteen route families shown as paired 1440 by 1024 desktop and 390 by 844 mobile technical blueprint wireframes.
svg.metadata: Generated for the Unilog repository. No external assets. Blue denotes active state, annotation, or evidence target.
svg.text: 14 route families · paired 1440×1024 desktop and 390×844 mobile frames · 768px reflow notes in the HTML atlas
BLUE = ACTIVE / ANNOTATION / EVIDENCE TARGET · MONOCHROME = STRUCTURE · DASHED = ALTERNATE STATE
